svg.text: Master bedroom air-handler shield — PCB floor plan, component side
UNO R4 WiFi shield, 86.36 × 53.34 mm, 2 layers. Millimetres from the bottom-left corner. Plan: docs/mbr-air-handler-shield-pcb-plan.md
Generated by docs/mbr-air-handler-shield-pcb-layout.gen.py. Body outlines at planned centres; the routed board is the authority.
24 VAC side (dashed); bus R · C · Y2 · W2 on the solder side along y 33–34
24 VAC from the Unico SCB thermostat block, 26–16 AWG
SCB EAC dry contact: blower running (optional)
24 VAC side: entry, half-wave rectifiers, relay coils
5.1 V from the converter to the R4's 5V pin
logic inputs Y2, W2, FAN, FLOW
dashed grey: the R4 under the shield; keep its area clear of leads
Header pins used: 5V (supply in from U1), GND, A0 A1 air, A2 FAN, A3 FLOW, SDA SCL to U2, D8 Y2, D9 W2, D2 only through JP1 (1-wire rollback).
U1, C1 and the terminals stand 9–16 mm tall: a second shield stacked above needs extended headers.
Primary bus R · C · Y2 · W2 runs on the solder side; +5 from U1 pin 6 crosses it on the component side.
